study_name: Human Colon Preview Data (Xenium Human Colon Gene Expression Panel)

panel.description: 325 pre-designed genes covering absorptive enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, goblet cells, Paneth cells, fibroblasts and vascular endothelium, plus 100 add-on signaling/chemokine and stromal marker genes.

Xenium_V1_hColon_Cancer_Add_on_FFPE_dono.description: Cancer donor for the 10x Human Colon Preview release (tissue sourced from Discovery Life Sciences). 10x publishes no donor identifier, so donor_id is a package-local key.

Xenium_V1_hColon_Cancer_Add_on_FFPE.sample_name: Xenium Human Colon 1 - Cancer, pre-designed + add-on panel
